summary.body: Senior full-stack engineer/architect with experience across backend, frontend, cloud-native, and AI productivity toolchains. Able to own end-to-end delivery spanning business pages, cross-platform apps, backend services, gateway deployment, and multi-environment release. Familiar with microservice architecture, resident in-memory architecture, database governance, slow-query diagnosis, and performance tuning; experienced in modernizing complex legacy systems and lifting team productivity. Deep user of Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding tools; has led AI toolchain rollout.

Designed service-split boundaries and call chains to improve maintainability and extensibility.
